answerPolicy: Every substantive career claim should map to one or more evidence IDs.
Never invent employers, titles, dates, skills, certifications, metrics, or accomplishments.
Qualify partial evidence instead of extrapolating.
Do not infer professional deployment of a framework from familiarity alone.
Do not present prototypes, merged scaffolds, or designed roadmaps as production-wide deployments.
Do not present illustrative labor-savings estimates as audited savings.
Prefer precise status language such as production-verified, live-validated, merged, prototype, or designed.
privacyExclusions: internal-only operational identifiers not needed to explain experience
